description: He wears a knee-length forest-green tunic with wide gold-toned knotwork borders at the front, cuffs and hem. A cream underlayer appears at the throat and wrists. A substantial green and brown checked woven cloak crosses the shoulders and drapes down the sides, secured near anatomical right shoulder by a circular ornate brooch. A broad brown leather belt with circular decorated fittings and a hanging patterned end shapes the waist. Brown trousers tuck into tall brown leather boots with crossed wrap straps. The sleeves are long and all garments opaque. Craftsmanship is refined, with noble ornament and natural textile texture rather than armor. Exact materials are visually uncertain.
